en.headline: Education Amendment Bill to be gazetted tomorrow with teacher practice certificate rules
en.dek: The bill will require teachers at all schools to hold a practice certificate lasting up to three years and introduce safeguards for national security convictions.
body: The government will gazette the Education (Amendment) Bill 2026 tomorrow, introducing a requirement that teachers hold a professional practice certificate in addition to registration.

Under the proposals, teachers and principals at publicly funded schools, private schools, international schools and kindergartens must possess both registration and a practice certificate before they can teach. Certificates would be valid for no more than three school years and applicants must meet continuing professional development requirements.

The bill also sets out a mechanism to handle the registration of people convicted of offences endangering national security, to prevent them from teaching in schools. The Education Bureau said the changes aim to raise professional standards and protect students.

The bureau has consulted the sector since September 2025 and the Legislative Council Panel on Education in February. Stakeholders and lawmakers generally supported the proposals. The bill is scheduled for first and second readings in the Legislative Council on 25 November.

zh.headline: 《2026年教育（修訂）條例草案》明日刊憲 引入教師執業證明書
zh.dek: 草案規定所有學校教師須持有有效期不超逾三個學年的執業證明書，並設立機制處理干犯國安罪行人士的註冊事宜。
body: 政府將於明日在憲報刊登《2026年教育（修訂）條例草案》，引入教師執業證明書要求，完善教師註冊機制，並設立機制處理被裁定干犯危害國家安全罪行人士的教師註冊事宜。
條例草案訂明，所有公帝資助學校、私立學校、國際學校及幼稚園的教師（包括校長）必須持有教師註冊及執業證明書，方可任教。執業證明書有效期不超逾三個學年，申請人須符合持續專業發展要求。
草案亦設立防護機制，防止被裁定干犯國安罪行的人士在學校任教，以保障學生及維護教師專業操守。教育局表示，修例旨在提升教師專業地位及加強管理，最終目標是保障學生福祉。
教育局自2025年9月起諮詢業界，並於今年2月諮詢立法會教育事務委員會，持份者及議員普遍支持。條例草案將於11月25日提交立法會首讀及二讀。
